description: Declared case list for ticket 19's public SQL-operations family, plus ticket 13's tracer-bullet case, which shares the scenario directory and is therefore discovered and executed by the same invocation. Tooling input only: the testcase repository does not depend on it. Requirement IDs come from each case's own header and from expected-oracle.md. No hand-derived assertion count is declared for the eight new cases: the SQL seam has no counter (ticket 35 F3, so executed.assertion_count is null either way), a count would have to be a hand tally of result cells across statements that return 1, 3 and 4 rows, and CTP compares the whole result text, so a byte-identical .result already entails that every cell matched. Ticket 13's case keeps the 27 it has always declared.

cbrd_26659_oos_rep02_largest_first.assertion_count_derivation: ticket 13's hand-derived count, unchanged: 11 scalars per row group x 2 row groups + 3 in the final aggregate + 2 INSERT affected-row counts

cbrd_26659_oos_sql02_update.flagged_for_user_reason: Specification, Review, sign-off and deferral: the user signs off on every answer promotion whose case touches a Specification gap or an observed-versus-normative disagreement. This case's third group is the inline-attribute-only UPDATE, exactly where the pin (a fresh chain per record version, OOS-SQL-03, observation-only) and the accepted CBRD-27230 design (OOS-SQL-04, withheld) disagree, and its OOS-path evidence spec is the matrix's cited observation source for OOS-SQL-03. Kept here as well as in promotions.json so a manifest regenerated from this declaration alone cannot drop the gate (ticket 44 F2).

cbrd_26659_oos_sql06_triggers.flagged_for_user_reason: Specification, Review, sign-off and deferral: the user signs off on every answer promotion whose case touches a Specification gap or an observed-versus-normative disagreement. This is the case finding T19-F1 came out of, and its sixth group deliberately exercises the path where the pin contradicts OOS-REP-02's normative record gate. Kept here as well as in promotions.json so a manifest regenerated from this declaration alone cannot drop the gate (ticket 44 F2).
